name: Review: Chords, Strumming & Songs
instructions: Spend today reviewing across everything so far: chord shapes, strumming patterns, and full songs.
Notice which area (chords, rhythm, or song application) still feels weakest, and plan to spend extra time there going forward.
Play through your full setlist from yesterday one more time, focusing on smooth chord changes throughout.
Revisit today's video on the easiest two-chord shapes as a reminder of how far you have come since Day 5.
